blocked.reason: The snapshot supplies pointers only. This bounded preparation job performed no network retrieval, so the content, current accessibility, licensing, and internal unit boundaries remain unverified.
The catalog explicitly reports no textbook and provides no URL. Nothing was substituted or invented.
The aggregate assignment claim cannot be expanded into official units without retrieving and validating individual statements, ordering, dependencies, availability, and lawful reuse conditions.

retrieval_policy.kickoff_dependency_policy: The kickoff must remain completable from the local learner pack and standard Python; external materials are optional and cannot be completion prerequisites.
retrieval_policy.later_job_authorization: A later job may attempt catalog-listed public URLs only when its harness explicitly permits network retrieval.
retrieval_policy.restricted_content_policy: Never bypass authentication, paywalls, access controls, robots restrictions, or other technical or legal restrictions; record the material as blocked instead.
promotion_requirements: Record the resolved URL, retrieval result, and stable provenance without embedding secrets.
Determine ownership and lawful reuse separately from the CSDIY catalog's MIT license.
Validate title, type, course association, ordering, prerequisites, and content boundary before creating an official unit node.
Keep unavailable or ambiguous records blocked; a link alone is not evidence of usable material.
Do not expose restricted, sealed, examiner-only, or cross-learner content in student-safe views.
